placements.title: Fallback-Guaranteed Slug Generation
placements.theme: Every memory commits successfully because the pipeline always resolves a slug — via LLM id-generation when available, and via deterministic slugify when not — so absence of an explicit id never blocks a commit.
placements.why: src-1 establishes the triggering condition (no explicit id supplied) and src-2 states the governing requirement (the pipeline must derive a slug from content via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback, and commit must succeed). Together these describe a durable architectural guarantee about the pipeline's id/slug-generation behavior, not a one-time fact or measurement — future envelopes about this pipeline's id-generation robustness would keep feeding this same theme. No existing narrative leaf or strata name (the supplied structure is empty) covers this, so it is minted under the newly-minted Architecture strata as its home category.
